messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Update to {ape} version 5.4-1
parts:
Hello {poppr} users,

There was a bug in the bootstrapping function from {ape} that caused
bootstrap values to be zero. This was recently fixed and is up on CRAN.
I would HIGHLY recommend getting this update by using
install.packages("ape"). If you have windows, you will need to wait a
couple of days for the binaries to build, but you can check that you
have the correct version with packageVersion("ape"). If it returns
"5.4.1", then you are good to go :)

Best,

Zhian
